name: 60426 · Harvey, IL
findings: ZIP 60426 (Harvey) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (63% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60426 (Harvey) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60426 (Harvey) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 23 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
